headline: Jaykay Enterprises Limited: Rights Issue
sum: Rights Issue - Jaykay Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors at its meeting held on July 13, 2026, has considered and approved the Rights Issue of Partly paid-up Equity Shares of the Company.
